lang.lineage.narutorpg.aburame.desc: The Aburame Clan is a well-known clan of Konohagakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.akimichi.desc: The Akimichi Clan is a well known clan of Konohagakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.amagiri.desc: The Amagiri Clan is a clan that founded Yumegakure, and one of the three clans that hail from the village.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.chinoike.desc: The Chinoike Clan was a clan active during the Warring States Period.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.clanless.desc: No bloodline - only the academy basics and hard work.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.fuma.desc: The Fūma Clan is a renowned ninja clan distantly related to the Uchiha Clan, famous in at least Amegakure and the Land of Fire.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.fuma_sound.desc: The Fūma Clan is a shinobi clan from the Land of the Rice Fields, where Orochimaru established the Land of Sound.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.funato.desc: The Funato Clan is a clan of pirates in the Land of Water.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.hagoromo.desc: The is one of the earlier clans which existed during the war-torn era preceding the creation of the hidden villages.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.hatake.desc: The Hatake Clan is one of the many clans that reside in Konohagakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.hirasaka.desc: The Hirasaka Clan is one of the three clans that hail from Yumegakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.hoki.desc: The Hōki Family is a matrilineal shinobi clan (and family) of medical-nin and information gatherers from Sunagakure, who originated in and moved down to the village of Konohagakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.hoshigaki.desc: This shinobi clan is from Kirigakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.hozuki.desc: The Hōzuki Clan is a group of ninja that settled in Kirigakure after the ending of the Warring States Period.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.hyuga.desc: The Hyūga Clan or Hyūga Family is a well known clan of Konohagakure, as well as the strongest clan in the village, standing alongside the Uchiha Clan, with the Hyūga said to also possess the oldest and most...
lang.lineage.narutorpg.iburi.desc: The Iburi Clan was a seclusive clan that lived underground in the Land of Fire.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.inuzuka.desc: The Inuzuka Clan or Inuzuka Family is a family of shinobi in Konohagakure known for their use of ninken as fighting companions and are easily identified by the distinctive red fang markings on their cheeks.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.izuno.desc: The Izuno Clan is a family of shinobi in Konohagakure known for their use of cat-inspired ninjutsu.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.jugo.desc: This clan is an unnamed family, which originated from an unknown area.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.kagetsu.desc: The Kagetsu Family hail from Motoyoshi Village within the Land of Fire.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.kaguya.desc: The Kaguya Clan is a now extinct clan, known for their savage battle tactics and archaic values, and as descendants of Kaguya Ōtsutsuki, a select few have inherited a derivative of her original ability to manipulate...
lang.lineage.narutorpg.kamizuru.desc: The Kamizuru Clan was a clan of bee users from Iwagakure who were once very well-known and revered.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.karatachi.desc: This family was a group of people from Kirigakure, which has produced renowned shinobi.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.kazekage.desc: This shinobi clan from Sunagakure holds high influential authority in its village.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.kedoin.desc: The Kedōin Clan is a small clan led by Agari Kaisen.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.kodon.desc: The Kodon Clan is a clan of the Howling Wolf Village.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.kohaku.desc: The Kohaku Clan was a shinobi clan that had a village near the border of the Land of Fire to that of Amegakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.kumanoi.desc: The Kumanoi Clan was a clan of the Howling Wolf Village.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.kurama.desc: The Kurama Clan is a clan of extremely skilled genjutsu users, exclusive to the anime.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.lee.desc: The Lee Clan is one of the many clans that reside in Konohagakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.nara.desc: The Nara Clan or Nara Family is one of the many clans of Konohagakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.onikuma.desc: The Onikuma Clan is one of the many clans that reside in Konohagakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.otsutsuki.desc: The Ōtsutsuki Clan is an ancient clan of horned humanoid creatures known as celestial beings, and also described as aliens from another planet, and revered as equivalent to gods.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.rinha.desc: The Rinha Clan was a clan with specialists in medical ninjutsu.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.ryu.desc: The Ryū Clan was once a powerful clan of Dragon Guardians entrusted with keeping the Dragon Blade.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.sarutobi.desc: The Sarutobi Clan is an influential clan from Konohagakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.sendo.desc: The Sendō Clan is a clan of the Howling Wolf Village led by Jiryū Sendō.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.senju.desc: The Senju Clan was one of the clans responsible for founding the first shinobi village: Konohagakure — the other being their rival Uchiha Clan.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.shiin.desc: The Shiin Clan was a small shinobi clan from the Land of the Rice Fields, where Orochimaru established the Land of Sound.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.shimura.desc: The Shimura Clan is a shinobi clan from Konohagakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.shirogane.desc: The Shirogane Clan was a puppet clan from the Land of Wind.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.taketori.desc: The Taketori Clan is a clan, presumably outside of Konohagakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.tenro.desc: The Tenrō Clan is a clan of shinobi that hail from Yumegakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.tsuchigumo.desc: The Tsuchigumo Clan is a clan that formed a pact with the Third Hokage during the Third Shinobi World War.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.uchiha.desc: The Uchiha Clan is a well-known clan of Konohagakure, reputed to be the village's strongest because of their elite battle prowess and the Sharingan.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.uzumaki.desc: The Uzumaki Clan was a formerly prominent clan in Uzushiogakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.wagarashi.desc: The Wagarashi Family is a clan in the Land of Tea.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.wasabi.desc: The Wasabi Family is a clan from the Land of Tea.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.yamanaka.desc: The Yamanaka Clan is a family of shinobi found in Konohagakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.yoimura.desc: The Yoimura Clan is a clan that resides in Daidai Village.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.yota.desc: This travelling clan had the ability to manipulate weather, which they used for their trades.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.yotsuki.desc: The Yotsuki Clan is a clan from Kumogakure.
lang.lineage.narutorpg.yuki.desc: The Yuki Clan lived in the Land of Water.
